Three levels per variable, and each level has a DIFFERENT MECHANICAL
EFFECT. A level that only sends a different message is theatre:
action -> do something that changes the value
gate   -> refuse to start a new cycle
TWO VARIABLES ONLY. CPU temperature, network and cloud quota are
defended variables 3, 4 and 5 and are deliberately NOT here. Building
five actuators at once produces alarm crosstalk: the disk cleanup
causes a CPU spike, which raises a thermal alarm, which throttles,
which slows the cycle, which raises a duration alarm. That is not
homeostasis, it is an autoimmune disorder. See

_why: The box has 14188 MB total. 600 MB free is the point below
which loading the 3b model at all is a gamble, and a cycle that
starts and then cannot think has spent the night for nothing.
action at 15% free = 85% used; it releases at 20% free = 80%
used. The reason is physical, not cosmetic: NTFS reserves
around 10% for the MFT, and below 80% real free space the
allocator fragments and write latency goes nonlinear.
If an action fires and does NOT bring the value back past the
release point, the action is marked INSUFFICIENT: it is not
repeated for 24 hours, and the next arrival at the action level is
treated as the GATE level instead. The system does not fight a
symptom it cannot move; it escalates to the human.
80% growing at 0.01%/hour and 80% growing at 5%/minute are the
same distance and opposite situations. Distance alone cannot tell
them apart, so every defended variable also carries time-to-
